notes.title: Patch 1.07: Optimize processes and BGM
notes.content: [p]The content of this repair:[/p][p]1. Optimizing the Easily Stuck Process (Exploration in Chapter Four) :[/p][p]Now, you won't loop through the cabin N times anymore. Before the conditions are met, you will not be allowed to go out and will be given clues.[/p][p]2. Unify the loudness of BGM:[/p][p]Now all the BGM has been aligned in terms of loudness and volume, and there will no longer be any fluctuations in pitch or volume.[/p][p]3. Fixed a BUG in the plot:[/p][p]Fixed the timeline BUG of a certain event and improved the story of a certain person.[/p][p]At present, the malicious bugs in the game have been fixed. Here, we express our sincere gratitude to all the players who provided feedback.[/p]

notes.title: DEMO of The Throne of The Monster [Chapter1:The Gilded Dead] is now available
notes.content:
[b] Dear Players: [/b]

Fantasy drama AVG "Monster's Throne" has now launched [b] new trial version [/b], including the complete plot of the first chapter and basic gameplay, you are welcome to try and taste.

It would be a great inspiration for us to get your attention and add our game to our wish list. Thank you for your support!

* The development version does not represent the final product, drama, exploration and combat are still in the future
